pages.title: The spatial eigenvalue
pages.text:
The spatial eigenvalue
λh = − |a|∆x (1 − cos θ) − 4D∆x2 sin2(θ/2) − i a∆x sin θ.
Its real part damps the mode; its imaginary part transports its phase.

pages.title: The leading spatial error
pages.text:
The leading spatial error
λh = −iak − Dk2 − |a|k22 ∆x + O(∆x2).
Upwind advection is ﬁrst order. Pure centered diﬀusion removes the O(∆x) term.

pages.title: Conservation is compatible with instability
pages.text:
Conservation is compatible with instability
The alternating mode remains mean-zero while its magnitude grows.
|1 − 4µ| ≤ 1 ⇐ ⇒ 0 ≤ µ ≤ 12 .

pages.title: The scope of Fourier analysis
pages.text:
The scope of Fourier analysis
Constant coeﬃcients and periodic translations make the modes independent.
A boundary,
variable coeﬃcient or nonlinear reaction introduces additional structure that this
calculation does not analyze.
Computational Cardiology Notes 19 / 19
